sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 10978 of 2023

Applicant :- Vijay Sahni
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Vivek Singh Shrinet
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mayank Kumar Jain,J.
Learned A.G.A. has informed that service of notice upon opposite party no.2 is sufficient.
Heard Sri. Vivek Singh Shrinet, learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

The present second bail application has been filed on behalf of applicant in Case Crime No. 55 of 2021 under Sections 363, 366, 376 IPC and Section 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station Khorabar,
District Gorakhpur with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.
The first bail application is rejected vide order dated 19.01.2023 in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 14540 of 2022.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 14540 of 2022
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in the present case.

The ground taken in the second bail application is that the applicant is in jail since 21.02.2021 and there is no likelihood of concluding of trial which is clear from perusal of the order sheet and after framing of the charge none of the witnesses have been examined.

Lastly it is submitted that applicant languishing in jail since 21.02.2021 having no criminal history and in case, he is released on bail he will not misuse the liberty of bail and shall Vijay Sahni vs State Of U.P. on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/163473535/
1 cooperate in trial.

entities.text: Vijay Sahni vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Per contra, the learned Additional Government Advocate has opposed the prayer for grant of bail and argued that status of trial is placed on record and 23.05.2023 is fixed for recording of witnesses.

It is also submitted that the age of the victim was minor at the date of incident and in her statement recorded under Section 164 she made specific allegation of committing rape upon her against the applicant.

Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of allegations and gravity of offence, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Court is of the opinion that no case for grant of bail is made out.
Hence, the bail application is hereby rejected.
Any observation made above shall not be treated as any finding on the merit and shall not prejudice the trial.
Trial Court is directed to record the statement of informant and the victim within two months from the date of production of certified copy of this order before the trial court.
